verse.verse_1: Perish the two hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he!
verse.verse_2: His substance availed him not, nor that which he earned.
verse.verse_3: Anon he shall roast into Fire having flame.
verse.verse_4: And his wife also: the firewood carrier;
verse.verse_5: On her neck shall be a cord of twisted fibre.
